title: Is it time for Congress and INDIA bloc to take a leaf out of CJP's playbook?
content: The INDIA bloc, under Congress's leadership, is gearing up for a vigorous campaign against electoral misconduct and the Election Commission's authority. Their strategy includes widespread protests and a pivotal 'Save Democracy March' to elevate public consciousness while pressuring for essential reforms. Additionally, the bloc intends to approach the Supreme Court about ongoing electoral challenges. Among their key proposals are reinstating ballot voting and refining voter registration methods.

title: 'I grabbed the terrorist': Flydubai passenger tells Netanyahu how he subdued pilot

Although drinking stations are now available, bottled water will continue to be provided throughout the school year.

title: Man paid $2.48 for old document; a year later, it sold for $477,650

Upon delving into its history, Sparks recognized its immense value and chose to auction it. title: Ohio farmer with $1m medical debt sold land after officials blocked solar lease

He has emerged as an advocate for farmers' property rights to help protect others from similar hardships.

title: India's monsoon rainfall ends 13% below normal, fourth-lowest since 2001

Despite a late surge in rainfall, several areas faced substantial deficits, particularly Punjab and South India. The overall monsoon season ended as the driest since 2015.

title: Meet the pudu, world’s smallest deer, barely four apples tall

The northern variety, measuring just 32 to 35 cm at the shoulder, holds the title of the world's smallest deer. Conversely, the southern pudu is slightly larger, reaching 35 to 45 cm. Both species thrive in dense forests and are known for their elusive nature, making them challenging to spot.
